task_text: I'm planning a home workout in 20 minutes. Clear some floor space for me, put out anything I'd need for exercising, make sure I have something to drink, and get the bathroom ready for a shower afterwards.

plans.R1:

- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the cup with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the filled cup on the counter for easy access during the workout. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the plate from the sink basin. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the plate on the shelf to clear space. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the knife from the sink basin. (r1_s6)

[15-20 min]

This plan focuses on clearing and organizing the kitchen space, ensuring you have water available, and preparing the area for post-workout activities.
